title: CultureVidBench: Benchmarking Cultural Understanding in Text-to-Video Generation

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating text-to-video models on generated prompts containing specific cultural elements (e.g., rituals, material culture, social practices) and assessing the outputs for cultural faithfulness, cultural consistency, and multimodal cultural rendering using both human evaluators and Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs).

Comparing the cultural accuracy and general generation performance of text-to-video models across 12 different countries and 8 world cultural regions to identify disparities between high-resource regions (e.g., the United States) and underrepresented regions (e.g., Ethiopia, Malaysia).
